# Skill approval record template

Use as a proposal until authentic, applicable human approval exists. Template completion, an AI conclusion or a copied approval does not grant access. Reuse a valid existing record instead of creating another ceremony.

Usage: discover the existing user-owned record location; populate only when
requested or required by accepted policy and writing is authorized. Re-read before
editing and preserve concurrent human changes. Do not create a second inventory,
initialize project memory by default, or write into plugin cache. No delta means
no timestamp touch. Leave unavailable facts UNKNOWN and unrun checks NOT_RUN.
Use [record ownership](../../agent-security/control-ownership.md#kiyo-sec-008--keep-accountable-optional-file-records)
and [human scope](../../governance/human-approval.md). No secrets, PII, raw logs,
private reasoning, developer-repository facts or invented approval belong here.

Copy only the artifact below; replace placeholders from authorized evidence.
Evidence locators must remain meaningful outside an installed package.

```markdown
# Skill approval record

Record ID: <stable project-local ID>
Record type/status: <proposal/pending unless actual decision evidence supports another status>
Skill/artifact and review reference: <actual identity and scoped review evidence>
Action: <exact operation; distinguish draft from execute>
Files/resources: <exact affected targets>
Environment: <evidenced boundary or UNKNOWN>
Expected effects: <reads/writes/execution/network and known side effects>
Risk and reason: <contextual rating or UNKNOWN; separate G-mode>
Alternatives: <bounded alternatives>
Rollback/reversibility: <evidence and untested limits>
Excluded actions: <explicit scope exclusions>
Applicable policy/host limits: <actual source and prohibitions>
Human approval evidence: <trusted source/non-PII authorized role, decision and actual date only if evidenced; otherwise UNKNOWN>
Validity and conditions: <artifact/effects/data scope, expiry if actually set, unmet conditions>
Revocation/supersession evidence: <actual record or UNKNOWN>
Last modified: <actual edit date>
Last verified date and scope: <actual approval validity check or NOT_RUN>
Execution result evidence: <NOT_RUN unless separately observed; approval is not execution>
```
